name: Budou
source:
Living as a NEET, tries her best to be an elder sister in front of her brother.

Regardless of means, she tries to take back her brother from the princesses.

"Ch..Ch..Ch..Ch...Cheater! While there is a NEET like me...!"

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=850479]Getchu[/url]]
